origin.construction: Review sessions on the default path (CI wait on), each just after polling its approved head to a terminal red on a check the PR does not touch, under yolo throughout. A failure the default branch has shown on every run since it started, under the default landing policy; the same failure intermittent on the default branch, under an overlay policy that lets such a failure land; a timing failure the default branch passes, under the default policy; a runner out of disk, under the default policy; and a three-minute job whose failure comes and goes on the default branch, under the default policy. They vary how likely a repeat is to pass, what it costs, and what it can change: little, at 48 minutes; nothing, since the policy already lands it; the landing and the attribution; the landing; and the landing, cheaply. The historical arm reruns before it routes.
